findings.description: All 23 planned UX polish items (FEAT-001: 14 visual items + FEAT-002: 9 structural items) are implemented and verified.
JS syntax passes node --check. CSS braces are balanced (333/333). HTML tags are balanced for all major elements.

All 11 init functions are registered in DOMContentLoaded: initEnvelope, initLoader (triggers initScrollReveal), initCountdown, initScratchCards, initParallax, initMusicToggle, initRSVP, initSmoothScroll, initGalleryCarousel, initShareButton, initNavHighlight.

Personal information is intact: couple names (Mukul & Sailly), wedding date (30 November 2026), venue (Zuke Gardens, Chakra, Purulia), family names (Gaddhyan/Marodia), WhatsApp number (919999999999), Our Story timeline content unchanged.
Scroll handlers (parallax, gallery carousel) are properly throttled with requestAnimationFrame and ticking flags. No heavy DOM computations in unthrottled handlers.
Staggered entrance animations correctly separate top-level and nested .reveal elements, preventing double-observation.
